description: MISO real-time transmission binding constraints — the specific flowgates and facility limits currently constraining the market, with their shadow price ($/MWh of relief). A binding constraint is why LMPs diverge between nodes. Use for "why is MISO congested", "what transmission limit is binding", "which flowgate is driving the price spread".

kind.description: transmission = real-time transmission flowgates (default); subregional = sub-regional power-balance constraints; reserve = reserve-product constraints.

name: miso_binding_constraints
